name: Tool Use
definition: A decision point for assessing the Tool Use capabilities of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: No use of external tools, simple deterministic capabilities

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Limited suite of tools, limited (e.g. internal only) dynamic tool selection

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: No limitations on tool selection, high risk tool capabilities
